title: DMW: 66 OFWs, families receive P4-M assistance

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sixty-six overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) and their families in Batangas received a total of P4.075 million in financial assistance, according to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW). The assistance was distributed through the agency’s AKSYON Fund during the “Handog ng Pangulo: Serbisyong Sapat Para sa Lahat” event at the Batangas Provincial Capitol
